answer: Locks are recorded in hollow, expire in shale, and ledge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 38 aliases hence needs 45 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2162 identities would post 2174 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
